title: An agent recovers its governing rules after compaction without a peer telling it what they are
outcome: An agent recovers its governing rules after compaction without a peer telling it what they are
acceptance: A natural first post-compaction recovery follows that bootstrap and reads the relevant current guidance without a peer prompt; implementation tests and source inspection are reported separately from this observation.

Before work resumes after compaction, a bootstrap outside stored memories gives a bounded path through existing reads to current attributed project guidance without requiring a known key; pagination and full reads preserve attribution and do not promote notes or override current user instructions.
Recovery evidence distinguishes newly delivered startup or resume instructions from content carried only by a summary; context-generation labels alone are not proof of compaction or injection.

When the host's context generation for the session differs from the one recorded for it, or none is recorded, next with peek puts first in its reminders a directive to read memories through the continuation, and the relevant entries in full, before acting, worded as the host's report; the directive stays until that session has listed memories for that generation; tests cover a changed generation, an unchanged one, a session with no record, and the acknowledgement.

completion.summary: Verified natural post-compaction recovery before substantive work; all four unchanged acceptance criteria independently pass.
